scope: Grade 1: 300 word + 300 example final MP3 clips.
status: Automatic file/content/playback audit complete; full human pronunciation/listening review not performed.

ctc.decoding: unconstrained greedy; each final clip separately; no expected text supplied

whisper.batch: 20 final clips joined with silence; observed word timestamps used to map tokens
whisper.followup: Flagged clips transcribed individually, no expected-text prompt, no prior-text conditioning
whisper.caution: Batch timestamps can cross file boundaries; individual followups used to resolve these. Homophones, traditional characters, numbers, rhotics and very short clips can be misrecognized.

methods.pitch: Praat autocorrelation: 137 single-character words, followed by floor/ceiling sensitivity review for 15 candidates; screening only.
methods.waveform: Full decode, duration/sha256/signal/edge/padding checks. Context excerpts considered separately.

limitations: 600개 전체를 사람이 직접 청음한 검수는 수행하지 못했습니다.
음성 인식은 성조·경성·얼화 및 자연스러움을 보증하지 않습니다.
성조 자동 선별 및 인식 차이는 확정된 오독 목록이 아닙니다. 청음이 필요한 항목은 별도로 기록했습니다.

after.method: complete 大家好 retained; removed detached repeated 大 after measured trailing silence

recheck_20261117.reason: Independent unconstrained CTC identifies an extra 大 at .919–.939s after complete 大家好; cut in preceding quiet interval.

before.method: complete standalone utterance bounded in measured source silence

after.method: complete second 便宜 retained; remove first duplicate reading, starting in measured 0.38s inter-word silence

recheck_20261117.reason: Source CTC identifies two complete 便宜 readings. Retain second complete word, independently recognized as 便宜 by both CTC and Whisper, and cut in preceding 0.38s silence.

after.method: same-voice existing complete falling-tone word; 160ms lead and 350ms tail padding added
